Nobody had Andrew Scott spitting in someone's mouth on their 2026 bingo card.

Andrew Scott gave one of the most unexpected TV cameos of the year. The viral therapist cameo takes place in the opening scene of the A24 comedy series It Gets Worse. The series follows three university friends navigating messy relationships, bad jobs, and adulthood in their twenties, with guest appearances from stars like Lena Dunham. Reich noted that the scene was written into the script from early on to set the show's tone around blurred boundaries and self-involvement, and Scott eagerly agreed to the role.
